fullDescription: A sophisticated, editorial-style design system with a dark slate grey theme (#111827) and rose gold accents (#B76E79). It features a luminous 3D neural network background, high-contrast serif typography (Zodiak), and clean sans-serif labels (General Sans). Ideal for philosophical journals, high-end fintech, AI research portfolios, or immersive tech-noir storytelling platforms. The layout utilizes wide tracking, italicized serif accents, and subtle glassmorphism to create a premium, academic-meets-future aesthetic.
prompt:
## Resumo
An immersive dark-mode editorial layout named 'Luminous Dark Slate' that pairs a high-tech 3D neural background with classical serif typography and rose-gold metallic accents. The design emphasizes intellectual depth through technical visualizations and poetic spacing.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a deep slate grey background (#111827). Use 'Zodiak' (Serif) for headings (light weight, tracking-tight) and 'General Sans' (Sans-Serif) for all-caps labels (tracking-[0.4em], text-xs). Primary accent color is Rose Gold (#B76E79); secondary is Rose Light (#D4A5A5). Implement a 3D background containing 200+ small spheres (nodes) and thin connecting lines (opacity 0.25). On hover, nodes should glow and change colors to a warm sunset palette (#B76E79, #E8987B, #C98B8B, #A68BA4). Use backdrop-blur-sm (4px) for cards and a mix-blend-mode: difference for fixed navigation elements to ensure visibility over complex backgrounds.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Fixed Navigation Header
Fixed header with 100% width. Left side: Circular icon with a 1px #B76E79 border and a solid dot in the center, followed by 'The Kinetic Journal' in General Sans, uppercase, tracking-widest. Right side: Links for 'Archive' and 'Philosophy' in uppercase text-xs with 0.2em tracking. Use mix-blend-difference so the text remains white regardless of background brightness.

### Hero Section
Center-aligned section with wide vertical padding (pt-40). Feature a volume/issue label at the top: 'Vol. IV — Issue 02' encased by two 48px horizontal lines in #B76E79/40. The main title should be text-8xl Zodiak, with one word italicized in Rose Gold. Subtitle: text-2xl serif italic in white/60, max-width 2xl. Footer of hero includes author and read-time with Lucide icons (user, clock).

### Asymmetrical Narrative Grid
Grid with 12 columns. Left span (col-7): Large pull quote with a 7xl serif opening quote mark in #B76E79/20. Body text in white/70 with 2rem line height. Right span (col-5): A floating circular visualization card (400x400px) with a 1px #B76E79/20 border and 40% opaque background. Inside, show a technical SVG neural map and center-aligned labels in #B76E79.

### Three-Column Technical Grid
Horizontal section with top/bottom borders (1px #B76E79/20). Background is a faint #B76E79/5 tint. Three equal columns with uppercase tracking-widest headers in #B76E79. Body text is small, italicized, and philosophical in tone.

### Interactive Footer
Darker footer section (#000000/20) with a top border. Features a central 'sparkle' icon in a rose-gold ring. Dual CTA buttons: one solid #B76E79 with white text, one outlined with white/20 border. Bottom row contains copyright and social links (Twitter, Instagram) in 10px uppercase text with 0.4em tracking.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Neural Field — Interactive Three.js particle field acting as the primary background texture.
Initialize a Three.js scene with 220 MeshBasicMaterial spheres (radius 0.18, color #B76E79). Connect nodes within a distance of 10 using LineBasicMaterial (opacity 0.2). Implement a raycaster that detects mouse position: when the mouse is near a node, increase its scale to 2.2 and lerp its color through the sunset palette (#B76E79, #E8987B, #C98B8B, #A68BA4). Add a gentle camera drift that follows mouse movements (factor 0.02).

### Floating Visualization Card — A glassmorphic circle that contains technical diagrams and floats gently.
Create a 1:1 aspect ratio container with rounded-full (circle) shape. Border: 1px solid #B76E79/20. Background: #111827 at 40% opacity with backdrop-blur-sm. Animation: 'float' (6s ease-in-out infinite, translateY -10px to 0). Inside, place an SVG neural network with nodes that pulse in opacity (0.2 to 0.6).

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the background neural network opacity between 40-45% for visibility without obscuring text. MUST use 'Zodiak' for all narrative headlines to maintain the editorial feel. MUST NOT use vibrant greens or blues; stick strictly to the rose gold and slate grey palette to ensure a 'premium' atmosphere. All labels must be uppercase with tracking of at least 0.2em.

style.description: The style is defined by a deep dark slate base (#111827) contrasted with a vibrant rose-gold palette (#B76E79, #D4A5A5). Typography uses Zodiak for large, elegant serif headlines and Switzer/General Sans for technical body and label text. A key element is the 3D 'Neural' layer—a semi-transparent background with pulsing nodes and glowing connections that respond to user movement.
